notes.title: Tencent accuse Sony of trying "to fence off a well-trodden corner of popular culture" with their Horizon copyright lawsuit
notes.content:
This afternoon, a choice of two raging videogame lawsuits to report on. Firstly, a snippet from the on-going courtroom scrap between former Unknown Worlds executives and Krafton over the state of Subnautica 2's development, in which the former accuse the latter of changing their story about why the executives were fired.

I've decided not to write that one up because it feels like we are entering the realm of potshots over minutiae, rather than learning anything genuinely new about Subnautica 2 or its creators, but if you're interested, GamesIndustry.biz has your back. The parallel Tencent/Sony bust-up has the virtue of relative novelty. It gives me a whole different kind of headache. What's going on with this one, then?

Read more

notes.title: The Tencent survival game being sued by Sony quietly purges most Horizon-like content from its Steam page, bumps release date to late 2027
notes.content: We noted, when Light of Motiram was first unveiled in late 2024, that it looked a lot like Horizon: Zero Dawn—to the point that we also wondered whether it might earn the ire of Sony. It took the better part of a year, but sure enough, Sony eventually filed a lawsuit against Tencent, parent of Motiram studio Polaris Quest, calling the game a "slavish clone" of the hit Horizon games... Read more.

notes.title: Sony sues Tencent over Light of Motiram calling it a "slavish clone" of the Horizon Zero Dawn series
notes.content:
It was only a matter of time really on this one. Sony have now formally begun legal action against Tencent for Light of Motiram.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/07/sony-sues-tencent-over-light-of-motiram-calling-it-a-slavish-clone-of-the-horizon-zero-dawn-series/

notes.title: Sony are suing Tencent to "prevent irreparable harm" inflicted by Horizon knockoff Light of Motiram
notes.content:
Horizon Zero Dawn/Forbidden West publishers Sony have called in the lawyers over Tencent’s upcoming Light of Motiram, arguing in a lawsuit filing (spotted by Reuters) that the post-apocalyptic action adventure looks a little too much like their post-apocalyptic action adventure. The case alleges that Light of Motiram, currently in development at Tencent subsidiary Polaris Quest, is a "slavish clone" of Guerrilla Games’ original series, and seeks to block its release on copyright infringement grounds.

Read more

notes.title: Light of Motiram - which is definitely not Horizon Zero Dawn - is coming to PS5 and mobile, check out a 16-minute gameplay trailer
notes.content:
Light of Motiram, which has gained some critical ire due to its clear and ample "inspiration" of the Horizon series, is coming to PS5 and mobile platforms. Also, there's a 16 minute gameplay trailer out too! You can watch it yourself, and see just how far the comparisons go. Shocker, it's a lot like Horizon, and Palworld too?

notes.title: Welcome to LIGHT OF MOTIRAM on Steam
notes.content:
LIGHT OF MOTIRAM is an open-world survival game where you explore a world overrun by colossal machines, explore the vast open world, build your base of operations, advance technology, train Mechanimals, and take on formidable bosses. Starting from the primitive age, forge a new path of development. Defy the machination, survive with mechanimals.

Be the first to catch a glimpse of our exciting Trailer, featuring the captivating music by Oleksa Lozowchuk.

[previewyoutube=7bABDo5r5fg;full][/previewyoutube]
Join us on an epic journey as we explore a world of wonders and conquer challenges. Prepare to experience the following key features!

[b]OPEN WORLD[/b]
In a world where human civilization has ceased to exist, traverse grasslands, deserts, forests, and mountains to explore unique Mechanimals and mysterious ruins in different regions, unlocking the secrets of MOTIRAM.

[b]AUTHENTIC SURVIVAL[/b]
Facing primal civilizations, unpredictable weather, and lurking Mechanimals, you must make the most of every resource to maintain your survival. Overcome numerous challenges to establish a foothold in this untamed wilderness.

[b]BOUNDLESS CRAFTING[/b]
Utilize a realistic physics engine to build freely, creating sturdy fortresses or ingenious shelters. Every beam and brick follows genuine physical principles, unleashing endless possibilities.

[b]MECHANIMALS[/b]
Over 100 customizable Mechanimals await your taming and training, each possessing unique skills and growth potential. Through personalized customization, assign them exclusive combat modes and production traits, transforming them into your most powerful allies.

[b]DIVERSE COMBAT[/b]
Master precise dodging, blocking, and counterattacking, weaving through enemy attacks while seeking opportunities to strike back when defending against lethal blows. Don't forget your Mechanimal partners, who can significantly enhance your combat effectiveness.

[b]CO-OP GAMEPLAY[/b]
Gather your friends and take on the challenges of the wilderness together. No matter where you are, embark on adventures with your companions anytime, anywhere. Experience the game whenever you desire, with uninterrupted progress in monster hunting, resource gathering, and base construction.

Wishlist now to stay tuned for more updates and a gaming experience like no other!

notes.title: Tencent's big new survival game looks like Palworld wrapped in Horizon Zero Dawn, but it does have an interesting premise: 'Why can't human beings kill God?'
notes.content: Tencent is getting into the open world survival game business with a new game called Light of Motiram, set in a verdant jungle world dominated by massive machine monsters called—wait for it—mechanimals... Read more.

notes.title: LIGHT OF MOTIRAM takes Horizon Zero Dawn and turns it into a co-op survival game
notes.content:
Is this Palworld all over again? The copying here is pretty blatant. Tencent Games owned developer Polaris Quest revealed LIGHT OF MOTIRAM and it seems very familiar.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/11/light-of-motiram-takes-horizon-zero-dawn-and-turns-it-into-a-co-op-survival-game

notes.title: Light of Motiram is to PlayStation's Horizon as Palworld is to Pokemon, and it's pretty blatant
notes.content:
Honey, wake up, another blatant rip-off just dropped, and this one is bound to cause legal troubles sooner rather than later. Tencent Games and subsidiary Polaris Quest have just announced Light of Motiram, a 'legally distinct' take on PlayStation's Horizon series. The biggest surprise? It's an MMO coming exclusively to PC (for now).
